text:
Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne — a hard-working developer passionate about building clean, polished front ends and reliable full-stack features.

I’ve got 7 years of experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. In a recent project, I built embedded customer analytics for a B2B SaaS product and rolled it out to 140 customer accounts. I also built a streaming chat widget and Node proxy for an edtech product, helping achieve first token on screen in about 600 ms.

For your Angular 12 theme work, I can focus on turning the current website into solid static pages with careful attention to UI and design, while also handling the blog and job post pages cleanly from the provided APIs.

Would you like the static pages matched closely to the current site’s existing branding, or are you open to small design refinements too?
